tagline.en: Echo-Memory (Spatial Concat-Text) — an ablation of the Echo-Memory world model that feeds spatial memory in by concatenation.
tagline.zh: Echo-Memory（Spatial Concat-Text）——Echo-Memory 世界模型的一个消融变体，以拼接方式注入空间记忆。

en: Echo-Memory Spatial Concat-Text is an interactive world model in WorldFoundry, provided as a research ablation of the Echo-Memory family. From a starting image, plus text and a camera trajectory, it generates action-conditioned video for studying how memory is represented in world models.

This identity is a fixed recipe that wires spatial memory into the model by concatenating it with the text pathway, processing context in two chunks. It pairs the Echo-Memory checkpoint (CC-BY-4.0) with shared Wan2.1 components (Apache-2.0) through WorldFoundry's native diffusion pipeline and a frozen-context strategy. It takes image, text, camera-trajectory, and video inputs; the memory method is fixed, not chosen at runtime.

As an ablation it exists mainly to compare this spatial-concat design against other Echo-Memory memory strategies. You can run it with a researcher-supplied local checkpoint that passes strict architecture validation.
zh: Echo-Memory Spatial Concat-Text 是 WorldFoundry 中的交互式世界模型，以 Echo-Memory 家族的一个研究消融变体形式提供。从一张起始图像，加上文本和相机轨迹，它生成动作条件视频，用于研究世界模型中记忆的表示方式。
这个模型身份是一套固定配方，把空间记忆与文本通路拼接后注入模型，以两个 chunk 处理上下文。它通过 WorldFoundry 的原生扩散 pipeline 与冻结上下文策略，将 Echo-Memory checkpoint（CC-BY-4.0）与共享的 Wan2.1 组件（Apache-2.0）搭配。它接受图像、文本、相机轨迹与视频输入；记忆方法固定，不在运行时选择。
作为消融变体，它主要用于把这种空间拼接设计与 Echo-Memory 的其他记忆策略作对比。你可以用一个通过严格架构校验、由研究者提供的本地 checkpoint 来运行它。

whenToUse.en: Use it for research comparisons within the Echo-Memory family — specifically to study a spatial memory injected by concatenation with the text pathway.
whenToUse.zh: 适合在 Echo-Memory 家族内做研究对比——特别是研究以与文本通路拼接方式注入的空间记忆。

notFor.en: It's an ablation variant for research, not a general-purpose generator, and the memory design is fixed. Running it needs a researcher-supplied local checkpoint plus the shared Wan2.1 weights.
notFor.zh: 它是用于研究的消融变体，而非通用生成器，记忆设计也是固定的。运行它需要研究者提供的本地 checkpoint，以及共享的 Wan2.1 权重。
